title: Best practical Ds solver with theorem-backed certificate
statement: Synthesize efficient-score upper optimization, inductive fitting, exact Ds exchange refinement, held-out evaluation, and upper-bound gap reporting under the audited DS17 constraints. On the scalar population-conditionally-centered class (L), the full (M2)+(M3)+(M5) ordinary-stable class is eventually empty, so any margin-constrained output must be reported as constrained, priced by v_hat_K - Phi_hat_s, and non-inductive; the established compile route is the projected efficient-score interval rule with its DP ceiling. Off (L), DS18 proves that one exact non-centered law has a unique strict full-rank population optimum and almost-sure transfer through finite global regular Ds optimizers. The remaining practical problem is to select such a basin without global combinatorial optimization and to retain computable margins and value guarantees under perturbations of the law.

proof_location.section: OP7. Best practical \(D_s\) solver with theorem-backed certificate

warning: Do not expose a generic gate root as a certificate. DS18 supplies sufficiency and finite exchange-stable transfer only through global regular optimization for its named exact law; it does not prove basin selection by local ascent or perturbation robustness. No src/ implementation is authorized before the fresh DS18 audit.
